mapper.select: SELECT B.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, B.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT A INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON A.ACCT_NO = B.SEC_ACCT_ID where B.Y_N_HKSTOCKC = '01' AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND B.TRADE_PLACE = #{tradeMarket,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT B.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, B.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, B.Y_N_HKSTOCKC yNHkstockc, B.TRADE_PLACE tradePlace FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B where B.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.MIN_SALE_UNIT as minSaleUnit, A.SH_OR_ZH as hkseMarket FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD A where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T1.VALUE_DATE, T1.CCY, T1.referenceRateIn, T2.referenceRateOut FROM (SELECT T.VALUE_DATE, T.CCY, T.RATE as referenceRateIn FROM REFER_SETTLE_RATE_MANAGEMENT T where T.HKS_PRICE_TYPE = #{type_in} AND T.CCY = #{ccy} AND T.VALUE_DATE = #{vdate} )T1 left join (SELECT T.VALUE_DATE, T.CCY, T.RATE as referenceRateOut FROM REFER_SETTLE_RATE_MANAGEMENT T where T.HKS_PRICE_TYPE = #{type_out} AND T.CCY = #{ccy} AND T.VALUE_DATE = #{vdate} )T2 on T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE and T1.CCY = T2.CCY
